scope.description: Harden the independent regional compatibility validator and closed schemas for dataset-bound v2 bundles, including same-byte source-manifest replay and stable provenance, while retaining read-only validation compatibility for the frozen v1 HCC1395 bundle.

assumptions: The validator remains independent from producer grouping and topology kernels.
New seven-dataset executions use schema 2.0.0 and bind dataset identity, authority, all eight verified inputs, frozen parameters, timing and claim ceiling.
A v2 freeze is forbidden until the external production manifest is independently replayed as a closed contract and its identity plus SHA-256 remain stable through validation.
The existing schema 1.0.0 HCC1395 bundle remains a legacy read-only validation contract and cannot be relabeled as a new seven-dataset run.

step_verify.step: Add v2 closed-contract negative fixtures before accepting producer output.
step_verify.verify: Missing dataset, parameters, timing, inputs, duplicate role, unknown field and dataset mismatch fixtures all fail without writing FROZEN.
A valid v2 fixture passes and its validation receipt plus FROZEN marker bind dataset ID/order and producer semantic SHA.
The existing valid v1 fixture and frozen HCC bundle remain readable, while v1 cannot assert v2 dataset authority.

step_verify.step: Independently replay and lock the v2 production source manifest before freeze.
step_verify.verify: The validator emits ordered SOURCE_MANIFEST and SOURCE_MANIFEST_STABLE checks; exact production-7 and HCC1395-gate positive fixtures pass, while missing/extra/digest/run/order/role/path/contract/runtime/output/symlink negatives fail without FROZEN.

evidence.output_excerpt: [100%] Built target test_regional_compat_validator; regional compat validator integration PASS. The fixture set includes production manifest 1.0, HCC dataset-gate manifest 1.1 with 11 bindings, ordered 18-check receipt, and fail-closed manifest negatives.
Pinned clang-format 14 dry-run emitted no errors; git diff --check and 120-column audit also emitted no errors.

evidence.command: for file in schema/compat/*.json; do jq -e . "$file" >/dev/null || exit 1; done
evidence.output_excerpt: All compatibility schema documents parsed as JSON; the v2 validation receipt contract requires exactly 18 ordered checks including SOURCE_MANIFEST and SOURCE_MANIFEST_STABLE.
Project state, P0-P8 ledger and seven active task records had internally consistent non-overlapping write sets before task release.

deviations: The system PATH lacks clang-format-14; the already extracted Ubuntu 14.0.0 binary under /tmp/clang-format-14-root was used for the required targeted format and dry-run checks.

The system jsonschema CLI is the known Draft-2020-12-incompatible version and was not used. JSON syntax was checked with jq, while the independent C++ validator tests replayed every required closed v2 field and negative case. The child-local schema-fixture run reached only the expected compat-catalog digest mismatch after this schema changed; the parent task owns that catalog update and repository-wide pinned Draft-2020-12 rerun.
